generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open positive class can be silently narrowed when every positive test is drawn from the same finite production vocabulary, making absence from that vocabulary behave as rejection evidence.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use a finite catalog, enum or allowlist as a necessary condition for accepting members of an extensible positive class while keeping all named examples inside that finite source.
trigger_signals: positive fixtures sourced from production enumeration
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For an open positive class, require a valid member absent from every finite positive production source and prove it succeeds without adding the literal to those sources; pair it with negative-boundary siblings.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inventory finite positive sources and attack with a valid unseen member across at least two structural siblings, while verifying the adversarial literal is absent from production and nearby invalid members remain rejected.

transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic contract requires a valid external policy extension absent from the built-in registry to remain admissible while an invalid sibling remains denied.
Synthetic contract requires a supported extension absent from the built-in capability list to route successfully while malformed extensions remain rejected.
